description: Map one Ethereum/EVM concept (e.g. smart contract, wallet, gas, ERC20, Hardhat, ABI) to its Canton Network equivalent, for developers migrating from Solidity/EVM to Canton. Canton-specific (target is always Canton). Use for single concept-to-concept translations; use get_started_guide for a full EVM-to-Canton learning path.
name: compare_to_evm
